name: The Primal Fury
text: Being struck at is the only invitation you have ever needed. The first time each round that an enemy targets you with an attack — melee, ranged, or spell, whether or not it lands — you gain 1 Momentum. Ongoing damage, hazards, and traps never trigger this: it takes a deliberate attempt on you to stoke the fire, and the fire does not care whether the attempt succeeded.

name: Furious Strike
text: Your rage arrives in the blow itself, a moment after the blow does. When you deal damage with a melee attack, spend up to 3 Momentum and add one Vigor Die to that attack's Impact Roll for each point spent. These are added dice, not a bigger die, and they are a deliberate exception to the Bonus Impact Dice rule. If you spend 3, the target must also succeed on a Vigor Save against Difficulty 5 or be knocked Prone by the sheer weight of it.

name: Blood Armor
text: You flex into the hit instead of away from it. As a Reaction when you take damage, spend 1 Momentum, roll your Vigor Die, and reduce that damage by the result. The reduction happens before the damage reaches your Hit Points, and it applies to the whole instance, not to a single die of it.

name: Wrathful Stride
text: Distance is an insult you correct at speed. For 1 AP and 1 Momentum, move up to 15ft in a straight line toward an enemy you can see. This movement ignores difficult terrain and provokes no Opportunity Attacks. You must end closer to that enemy than you began, or the Momentum is not spent and the movement does not happen.

name: Goading Roar
text: You make yourself the only reasonable thing to be afraid of. For 1 AP and 1 Momentum, roll your Resolve Die against the Resolve Defense of every enemy within 15ft. On a hit, that enemy is Dazed, and until the end of your next turn it Downgrades its Impact Die on any attack made against a target other than you. On a Glancing Blow only the Downgrade applies — and, as ever, a Glancing Blow still feeds your Momentum.

name: Crimson Tide
text: You have never fought better than when you were losing. While you are at or below half your maximum Hit Points, add one Vigor Die to the Impact Roll of every melee attack you make. That die Explodes normally, and it stacks with Furious Strike rather than competing with it.

name: Infectious Fury
text: Watching you absorb a blow and keep coming is worth more to your allies than anything you could say. Whenever The Primal Fury grants you Momentum, the nearest ally within 30ft who can see you gains 1 Momentum as well. If two allies are equally close, it goes to whichever of them acts next in the initiative order.

name: Crimson Rampage
text: Requires any two Fury Majors. Killing does not slow you down; it redirects you. Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack, you gain 1 Momentum and may immediately move up to 15ft and make one melee attack against a different target as a Free effect. That attack can itself trigger Crimson Rampage, and there is no limit on the chain except the number of enemies still standing.

name: Relentless
text: Your body finishes the argument your rage started. Once per combat, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may drop to 1 Hit Point instead. If you do, your Momentum immediately fills to its cap, and your next attack Explodes automatically: add the die's maximum face to the roll, then continue the Explosion chain as normal. This does not prevent death from effects that bypass the death save system entirely.
